levels.surface: عبد الملك بن شعيب بن الليث بن سعد

notes: «في رجال من أهل العلم» is an unnamed co-transmitter standing with the two named men at one level; it is not filled in.
The chain ends at «عائشة», whose own words relay the Prophet's saying; «قالت عائشة» later in the text is her narration, not a new link.
